title: An operator drafts and approves a newsletter, and the send gate opens only when both switches are up

backendBuild.detail: the in-repo fixture backend, not an API build (branch HEAD)

steps.name: sign in and open the newsletter screen
the consent standing is the SERVER's four figures, not a total
there is no gate yet, and there is no draft form either
steps.detail: no gate, no draft form; the audience is the stated precondition

steps.name: compute the audience — and it is NOT the consent total
THE FIRST STOP: the gate arrives closed, and both switches are named
steps.detail: 3 reasons, both flags among them; the send button is drawn and disabled

steps.name: the module switch also closes the TEST route, and the panel says so
steps.detail: test route closed by growth.module, input disabled

steps.name: right after a save the approval is informed, and the panel does not warn
steps.detail: no unseen-body warning: the boxes are the version being approved

steps.name: approve it — and now ONLY the two switches are left
